statement.p: Evaluate the line integral \int_{\mathcal{C}} \mathbf{F} \cdot \,d\ \mathbf{r} where \mathbf{F}=\left\lt 4 \sin x, -2 \cos y, 10 xz \right> and \mathcal{C} is the path given by \mathbf{r}(t) = ( t^3, -2 t^2, -2 t) for 0 \le t \le 1

static.solution:
\mathbf{F}(\mathbf{r}(t)) = \left\lt 4 \sin ( t^3), -2 \cos (-2 t^2), -20 t^4 \right> \mathbf{r} '(t) = \left\lt 3 t^2, -4 t, -2 \right > \mathbf{F}(\mathbf{r}(t)) \cdot \mathbf{r} '(t) = \left\lt 4 \sin ( t^3), -2 \cos (-2 t^2), -20 t^4 \right> \cdot \left\lt 3 t^2, -4 t, -2 \right > =12 t^2 \sin ( t^3) + 8 t \cos (-2 t^2) + 40 t^4
The line integral is then: \int_{\mathcal{C}} \mathbf{F} \cdot \,d\ \mathbf{r} = \int^1_0 \mathbf{F}(\mathbf{r}(t)) \cdot \mathbf{r} '(t) \ dt = \int^1_0 12 t^2 \sin ( t^3) + 8 t \cos (-2 t^2) + 40 t^4\ dt = \left [ -4 \cos ( t^3) - 2 \sin (-2 t^2) + 8 t^5 \right ]^1_0 = -4 \cos (1) - 2 \sin (-2) + 12
